title: MIDDAG Shared Props
description: Wire contract for the shared props sent with every page: auth, theme, flash, errors, csrf_token, locale, scope and navigation. The root is open so hosts and products can add their own keys. Generated from middag-io/ui PHP value objects (jsonSchema()).

errors.description: Validation errors of the current request: a FormErrors map or, when the request carried the X-Inertia-Error-Bag header, a FormErrorBags map of bag name to FormErrors. The wire is not self-describing: the reader that sent the header reads errors[bag]; any other reader treats the map as flat.

FieldMessage.description: A structured validation message: the server-resolved message plus the translation key, domain and optional params.

FormErrors.description: Validation errors keyed by field name. Each value is a message, a structured message (FieldMessage) or a list of either. The reserved key "_" carries form-level errors; dotted keys target nested fields.

FormErrorBags.description: Validation errors scoped to error bags: bag name to FormErrors.
